title: perfcheck dropped warns of a deleted test file that tested a live module beside a removed one, and a gate runs it
goal: perfcheck.py dropped warns of a deleted test file when any _tools/ module it imported (helpers left out) is still present, naming those modules, unless the reason names where their tests went (a successor test or file that exists); a reason that names only the dropped test itself no longer excuses it; the review step of a sprint (or sync's gate when test_ids_dropped.txt changes) runs it. Planted: the shape of test_autopilot_two_runners.py (a removed module beside a live kg_lock) is warned of. Found by the SP-6btkjg4l review: ST-kd7vnu5r's motivating case passes silently.

run:
import subprocess as S, sys, tempfile, pathlib, io, contextlib
R = pathlib.Path.cwd()
sys.path.insert(0, str(R / '_tools'))
import perfcheck
d = pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp()); t = d / '_tools'; t.mkdir()
w = {'mod_live.py': 'def f():\n    return 1\n', 'mod_auto.py': 'def g():\n    return 2\n', 'test_x.py': 'import mod_auto\nimport mod_live\n\ndef test_c():\n    pass\n', 'test_stays.py': 'def test_new():\n    pass\n'}
for n, s in w.items(): (t / n).write_text(s)
def git(*a): S.run(['git', '-c', 'user.name=t', '-c', 'user.email=t@example.com', *a], cwd=d, check=True, capture_output=True)
git('init', '-q'); git('add', '-A'); git('commit', '-qm', 'b')
(t / 'mod_auto.py').unlink(); (t / 'test_x.py').unlink(); git('add', '-A'); git('commit', '-qm', 'r')
def run(reason):
    f = d / 'drop.txt'; f.write_text('# ' + reason + '\n_tools/test_x.py::test_c\n')
    o = io.StringIO()
    with contextlib.redirect_stdout(o): perfcheck.main(['dropped', '--file', str(f)], root=d)
    return o.getvalue()
m = '_tools/test_x.py (1 id(s)) is gone, but modules it tested are still present: mod_live'
a = run('test_x.py went with mod_auto.py'); b = run('its mod_live tests moved to test_stays.py')
assert m in a, a
assert m not in b, b
